description:
Are you crustin'? Steve Carell and Charly Clive taste-test different pizzas while discussing college food memories, favorite gifts, and first‑day‑of‑college stories. 

A special thank you to UNO Pizzeria & Grill, Nate's Detroit Pizza, and John's of Bleecker St.

#Rooster premieres this Sunday, March 8 at 10pm ET on HBO Max
